dedupe_keys.name: eco data set electricity consumption and occupancy eth zurich

description: The ECO data set, Electricity Consumption and Occupancy, was collected by ETH Zurich's Distributed Systems Group in six Swiss households over eight months for research on non-intrusive load monitoring and occupancy detection. For each household it provides 1 Hz aggregate smart meter data with current, voltage and phase shift for each of the three phases, 1 Hz plug-level data for selected appliances, and occupancy information from manual labelling on a tablet and, in some homes, passive infrared sensors. It was gathered in the Smart Meter Services project and used with the open source NILM-Eval framework; an interactive dashboard to browse it is available on request. Coverage: six households in Switzerland. Access: zipped CSV and MATLAB files per household from the ETH data archive, with documentation. Licence: not stated; the authors ask to be told how the data will be used. Caveats: a small sample of homes over one period, so results do not generalise to national demand. Simulation uses are testing appliance disaggregation and occupancy detection, and occupancy-linked demand models for homes. Related records: UK-DALE and the IDEAL household energy dataset.
